title: Hard-coded IP address in Calculation
description:
Security / maintainability rule — calculation chunks with a literal IPv4 address (e.g. an FTP / SMTP host). Hard-coded hosts break on network changes.

Based on the PMD rule AvoidUsingHardCodedIP — https://docs.pmd-code.org/latest/pmd_rules_java_bestpractices.html#avoidusinghardcodedip
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A literal IP address pins the solution to one network and exposes infrastructure in the DDR.
rule.remediation: Move the host into a settings field / global; prefer a DNS name over a raw IP.
